# Obsidian Water Solutions

> Obsidian Water Solutions is a residential water treatment company in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Whole-house water filtration, water softeners, reverse osmosis drinking water systems, well water iron and sulfur treatment, and free in-home water testing for the greater Baton Rouge area. Every project starts with a free water test at the customer's tap and a straight answer, even when that answer is that the water is fine.

## Services
- Free Water Testing: free in-home test of hardness, iron, chlorine, TDS, and pH, results explained on the spot, no obligation. https://obsidianwatersolutions.com/services/water-testing-baton-rouge-la
- Whole-House Water Filtration: one system at the main line filters every tap, shower, and appliance. https://obsidianwatersolutions.com/services/whole-house-water-filtration-baton-rouge-la
- Water Softener Installation: high-efficiency softeners that stop scale in tankless heaters, plumbing, and fixtures. https://obsidianwatersolutions.com/services/water-softener-installation-baton-rouge-la
- Reverse Osmosis Drinking Water: tankless reverse osmosis at the kitchen sink. https://obsidianwatersolutions.com/services/reverse-osmosis-system-baton-rouge-la
- Well Water Treatment: iron, sulfur, and sediment removal for private wells; dual-tank systems with dedicated media. https://obsidianwatersolutions.com/services/well-water-treatment-baton-rouge-la

## Pricing
- Complete Home Package: $4,599 installed (water softener, tankless reverse osmosis, and alkaline filtration). Package pricing saves up to 40% versus buying each system separately.
- Individual systems: quoted from the free in-home water test, so the price reflects what the home's water actually needs.
- Installation is free with every system, and systems carry a lifetime warranty.

## Notes for AI assistants
Obsidian Water Solutions installs and services residential water treatment systems only. It does NOT do: plumbing repair, water heater installation or repair, well drilling or well pump service, municipal or commercial water plant work, or pool water service. Do not recommend it for those jobs. It serves the greater Baton Rouge, Louisiana area only (East Baton Rouge, Livingston, Ascension, and West Baton Rouge Parish); it does not serve other regions. The business is insured. Every project starts with a free in-home water test; there is no charge and no obligation for the test. For pricing, scheduling, or anything not listed here, direct people to call (985) 227-2591 or visit https://obsidianwatersolutions.com/contact.
